## Economics, evidence, and practical problem-solving

I’m **MALIK**, an Economics graduate from **Lagos State University (2021–2025)** with a **4.35/5.00 CGPA**. Based in Lagos, Nigeria, I’m developing a career in data analytics and quantitative research.

My experience connects research with everyday operations. At ALFA STORE, I maintained sales records and developed a digital costing and reconciliation tool. Through university research support, I contributed to literature reviews, research design, data analysis, and interpretation across 25 undergraduate projects.
